Photo 1 shows the same setup from a slightly different angle, with the grey box and console visible. The controllers appear to be custom or third-party, with 'ARC' branding on the black one.

Photo 2 shows the same setup from a top-down angle, with the white controller on the right and black on the left. The grey box and console are again visible, with the 'SENTINEL TASK FORCE' label and HDMI port clear.
All photos show a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI WILLIAMS GADGETS'.
The console appears to be a standard Xbox One model, not a limited edition or special edition, based on the design and branding.
